overall_goal: Dress, season, and toss the pasta salad

goals.description: Add pasta to the bowl, pour olive oil over the salad, and toss everything together
goals.rationale: The person adds the drained pasta to the bowl, pours olive oil over the ingredients, and mixes them thoroughly, returning any fallen pieces to the bowl.

goals.description: Season the salad with herbs and black pepper, then mix
goals.rationale: The person adds herbs, black pepper, and additional seasonings to the salad and gives it a final mix to distribute the flavors.
